route_policy: Conditional route contracts; none is selected or guaranteed.

routes.label: possible vampire state at the 2010 horizon
preconditions: player confirms it as desired target
causal future events and permission support an actual Embrace
meaningful post-Embrace experience covers body, Hunger/Beast, ties, society, power and costs under current rules
routes.if_unavailable: mark BLOCKED_DESIGN or unfinished; do not force, compress unplayed experience, or grant target-sheet traits

routes.label: possible mortal or non-vampire state at the horizon
preconditions: player approves this alternate target if the legacy vampire target is changed
routes.if_unapproved: do not count it as satisfying the legacy proposed target; keep scope decision pending

routes.label: truthful unfinished, refused, failed, absent or terminal state
preconditions: actual play or player choice causes it and evidence is persisted
routes.if_selected: preserve consequences and do not add plot armor; phase may close without passing the selected target

routes.label: pause or extend if plausibility cannot fit
preconditions: player approves changing target window or treatment of horizon
routes.if_unapproved: keep mismatch visible and block the dependent step

choice_contract.no_default: silence or continuation to later phases selects no route
choice_contract.safe_interim_work: documentary design independent of target selection

coverage_matrix.evidence: source-backed event, applicable rule and lived consequence
event-specific acquisition for protagonist and each NPC
formation, change, loss and 2010 continuity evidence
rule source, acquisition authorization and ledger
supported date or UNKNOWN; no invented off-screen event
